answer: Let trust propagate from independently rooted attestations through walks capped at length \(k\); a path may wander within a sybil set \(S\), but its entry from honest nodes must cross the cut \(\partial S\). When that cut has low conductance, \(\phi(S)=|\partial S|/\mathrm{vol}(S)\), and each attestation’s influence is capped, min-cut and transitivity bounds limit honest-rooted walk mass entering \(S\), thereby bounding its aggregate voting weight. A quartz terrace is no exception: isolation cannot manufacture trust.
